info.bio: Paul Westerberg (n. el 31 de diciembre de 1959) es un cantante nacido en Minneapolis, mejor conocido como el vocalista de The Replacements, una de las primeras bandas alternativas de los '80. Desde la separación de The Replacements en 1991, Westerberg ha grabado varios álbumes solistas bajo su nombre y como Grandpaboy, así como participado de numerosas bandas sonoras para películas, entre ellas "Singles" de Cameron Crowe.

scenes.name: Cantautores lo-fi de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Los noventa son la década del cantautor: la tecnología y las redes informales del post-punk favorecen la carrera en solitario, con Joni Mitchell y Leonard Cohen (no Dylan ni Springsteen) como maestros. El folk sombrío inaugurado por Chris Isaak, Smog y American Music Club se convierte casi en un género: Vic Chesnutt, Mark Lanegan, Mountain Goats, Elliott Smith, Jeff Buckley, Ron Sexsmith, Mike Johnson, Simon Joyner, Songs:Ohia. El neo-pop de Stephen Merritt (Magnetic Fields: Holiday, The Charm Of The Highway Strip, 69 Love Songs), Chris Connelly, Frank Black, Mike Gira (Body Lovers, Angels Of Light), Richard Davies y Eric Matthews (Cardinal), David Gray. El neo-folk de Beck (folk para la era del hip hop), John Frusciante, Sparklehorse, Bright Eyes, Rufus Wainwright, Grandaddy, Bobby Conn; el neo-country de Richard Buckner y Freedy Johnston; Steve Wynn, Mike Watt, Paul Westerberg, Ben Harper.

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …alter-ego of Husker Du. Their early albums were influenced by the epic frenzy of the Sex Pistols and the New York Dolls. But on Hootenanny (1983) Paul Westerberg emerged as a confessional and visionary songwriter, and the band began to spin blues, country, rockabilly and boogie while retaining the anthemic spirit (and the raw sound) of punk-rock. Let It Be (1984) slowed down the pace and toned down the guitars, giving Paul Westerberg the front stage and a messianic role. podcast.title: Anguished Confessional Lyrics
podcast.body: Paul Westerberg, leader of The Replacements, was known for his deeply personal, "anguished confessional lyrics." This lyrical style offered a sensitive counterpoint to the band's loud and raw musical delivery. "And then there was leader Paul Westberg's anguished confessional lyrics."

xref.title: Extensive Musician Dating History
xref.body: Winona Ryder, an actress, has been connected to or dated a significant number of musicians, totaling 22 individuals according to a count from the transcript. Her relationships included Dave Grohl, Ryan Adams, Pete Yorn, Jack White, Julian from The Strokes, Conor Oberst of Bright Eyes, possibly Jeff Tweedy from Wilco, Irish musician Damien Rice, Tre Cool of Green Day, Marky Walberg (Marky Mark), Stephen Jenkins of Third Eye Blind, Everlast (whose real name is Eric Shorty), John Kay from Jamiroquai, Adam Duritz of Counting Crows (who also dated Jennifer Aniston and Courtney Cox), Chris Isaak, Dave Pirner of Soul Asylum, Paul Westerberg of The Replacements (which was noted as potentially during her "Minneapolis punk period"), Mike Nesmith of The Monkees, Johnny Depp, and Evan Dando of The Lemonheads. The last heard connection was an engagement to Blake Sennett, who plays guitar in Rilo Kiley. "I count 22 musicians."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Musical Style
xref.body: The Replacements' philosophies were firmly rooted in punk, but with even greater pop sensibilities. The anguish and confessional nature of leader Paul Westerberg's lyrics provided a sensitive counterpoint to the volume and rawness of their music, a combination that proved effective. "His sensitivity might have been a strange counterpoint to the volume and the rawness of the music, but you know, somehow it worked."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Paul Westerberg's Confessional Lyrics
xref.body: The band's leader, Paul Westerberg, was known for his anguished and confessional lyrics. This lyrical sensitivity often provided a contrasting element to the loud and raw nature of their music, a combination that proved effective and resonated with listeners. "And then there was leader Paul Westberg's anguished confessional lyrics."
